name: BIOAQUA Turmeric Facial Serum 30ml Anti-Oxidation Soothing Acne Skin Hyaluronic Acid Control Oil Moisturizing Face Skin
description:
Anti-Oxidation | Soothing | Acne Care | Hyaluronic Acid | Oil Control | Moisturizing

Enriched with turmeric essence, this facial serum deeply nourishes and moisturizes your skin while controlling oil, soothing acne, and revitalizing dull skin. It helps eliminate acne scars and reduces the appearance of fine lines, leaving your skin soft, smooth, and radiant.

Key Benefits:

Acne Scar Removal: Turmeric essence helps fade acne marks and wrinkles for a clearer complexion.

Moisturizing & Nourishing: Deeply hydrates and replenishes the skin, restoring its natural radiance.

Gentle & Safe Formula: Suitable for all skin types, nourishing skin without irritation.

Skin Rejuvenation: Brightens dull skin, evens out skin tone, and promotes a youthful glow.

Easy Application: Fast-absorbing, non-greasy, and promotes skin elasticity and firmness.

Give your skin a natural glow, reduce spots, and enjoy soft, nourished, and healthy-looking skin with BIOAQUA Turmeric Facial Serum.

Country of Origin: China
